messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — noticed a recurring kernel stall on staging during the continuous-batching perf run at ~seq=2048. repro steps below.
Maya: thanks for flagging. is this only when microbatching is enabled?
Alex: yes, seems gated by microbatch_size <= 8 + hot-kv-evictions spike. logs show long spin in `kv_lookup()` followed by a stall.
Jia: can you paste the minimal repro command? I can try locally.
Alex: repro command we used:
```
./tools/bench_run --model=redwood-7b --seq=2048 --batch=16 --microbatch=4 --kv-shards=2 --warmup=100 --iters=200
```
Alex: observed tail latency jump to 800-1200ms and then one of the kernels hung (~5s) before recovery. stack trace points to kernel scheduling + cache eviction path.
Sam: cc @Maya @Leo — sounds like kernel scheduling + eviction interplay. Maya, any recent scheduler changes this sprint?
Maya: we tweaked preemption order for hotpath last week (PR #3421) but it only touched long-running kernels. Could be interacting with kv mutexes.
Leo: i can try toggling preemption off on a staging node and run the bench. assigning to me to run an A/B.
Jia: i'll add a lightweight eviction counter + timing probe to the runtime (small PR) so we can correlate stall -> eviction spikes. pinging @Sam for quick review.
Sam: ack. i'll review the PR today. small ask: add metric tag `eviction.reason` (prefetch|kv-oversub|compaction) so we can filter.
Alex: nice. also adding a perf trace capture would help — short but capture the KV queue depth and kernel queue length around the hang.
Maya: milestone/ownership sync: kernel team -> triage reproduce + confirm patch, runtime infra -> metrics/trace PR, eng-sre -> watch the canary.
Alex: proposed timeline: repro + trace by EOD today, metrics PR by tomorrow morning, canary run after PR merged.
Leo: running repro A/B now on staging-3. will report numbers here in ~10m.
OpsBot: canary deployment to staging started (deploy id: deploy-stg-20260317-8c1). Logs available at https://ci.redwood/devops/deploys/8c1 :rocket:
Jia: created PR #3689 with eviction counters + `eviction.reason` tag. simple change, unit tests included.
Sam: reviewing PR now. leaving inline comment about small alloc in hot loop. :eyes:
Alex: if the hang repros, let's hold any wide rollout of continuous-batching changes. prefer guarded canary.
Maya: agreed. also adding a quick doc note in the sprint board so PMs know this might affect throughput numbers.
Leo: staging A run complete: baseline (preemption on) median tail 90th=230ms, with microbatch=4 spike to 980ms with one kernel stall at iter 137. attaching short excerpt below:
```
iter=136 tail=220ms
iter=137 tail=980ms  <-- kernel stall
iter=138 tail=250ms
```
Alex: perfect — that's the same pattern. thanks Leo. next steps: @Jia land metric PR, @Sam review + approve, @Maya coordinate a gated canary once PR merged.
Sam: left one minor comment, should be quick to address.
Jia: will address now. planning to add a short dashboard panel for eviction rate vs tail-latency.
Maya: I'll set the canary to 10% with heavy seq=2048 traffic, 30m window. tagging infra and oncall.
OpsBot: canary created (canary-id: c-2048-10pct). monitoring alerts: latency-tail, eviction-rate.
Alex: thanks everyone. feel free to drop short updates here; i'll compile a brief note for the sprint sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Maya: update: will post canary results here once complete.
Leo: if anyone needs raw perf logs, they're at s3://redwood-staging/perf/2026-03-17/kernel-stall/
Sam: PR approved, merging after CI.
Jia: merged + metrics live. start canary when ready.
OpsBot: canary started (c-2048-10pct) — 5min in, eviction-rate up 4x on canary nodes, tail-latency trending +350ms vs baseline.
Alex: copying this into the sprint notes now. continuing async triage, will call for quick sync only if new info emerges.
Maya: good call. :eyes:
